It is suitable for all skin and hair types.How does it work?Electrolysis works by delivering an electric current via a fine sterile needle into the hair follicle. This electric current destroys the cells responsible for hair growth. The loosened hair is then removed with tweezers. Under the US Food and Drug Administration regulations, electrolysis is the only method that can claim to remove hair permanently. They are most commonly found in wrinkled skin or fold areas of the body such as the armpits, sides of the neck and in the groin area. Skin tags are also found on the eyelids and around the eye. Skin tags are not harmful but can be annoying as they can get caught in jewelry and clothes.Currently, there is no known cause as to why they occur, however a few factors are suspected: Irritation from skin rubbing together and chaffing, a resistance to insulin and the Human Papilloma Virus.
